description: This is a travel planning website consuming the REST Countries, YouTube, and Unsplash APIs for displaying country data, pictures, and embedded video guides.
Meal Generator is designed to assist busy individuals in effortlessly creating and customizing daily menus by generating meal ideas with detailed recipes.
This is a responsive web app for a Real Estate Agency with three public-facing pages and the Admin functionality which allows easy addition of data.
This app is for public art installations management. It provides an admin panel with CRUD operations, image uploads, and Google Maps to display their locations.
This app is a co-developed project with three parts: Cleaning Pipeline, Finance Tracker and Todo Items with CRUD, filters and authorization.
This interactive page showcases advanced knowledge of CSS transitions, transforms, and keyframe animations. It received top feedback for high code quality and creativity.
The Portfolio Page is a responsive website, designed to work seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and phone devices, based on Figma mockups with components and styles.
This landing page was designed as fully responsive website for the software development agency with lo-fi and hi-fi interactive prototypes of user interface.

This is a web app for creative professionals to showcase portfolios and services and get booked. It includes a client-facing site for exploration and bookings, a provider dashboard, and an admin panel.
